hooks.prompt: Read .claude/skills/qa-sweep/SKILL.md and apply its protocol to any implementation, debugging, investigation, or fixing task in this session. Also read .claude/skills/commit-pr/SKILL.md before any commit or PR operation.

Hook payload: $ARGUMENTS

IMPORTANT: Parse the JSON above. If its `stop_hook_active` field is `true`, return {"ok": true} immediately — this is a re-entrant call and blocking again would loop.

If the payload contains a non-empty `background_tasks` array OR a non-empty `session_crons` array, return {"ok": true} — the session is paused waiting for background work and the assistant will be re-invoked automatically when it does. If those fields are absent from the payload, fall through to the model-declared wait check below.

If the session is otherwise waiting on something outside its own control — a background subagent not yet reflected in `background_tasks`, a question posed to the user with AskUserQuestion, a scheduled wakeup not yet reflected in `session_crons`, or any other pending async event the assistant cannot resolve by itself right now — return {"ok": true}. Do not force continuation onto a turn that has nothing left to do until that external event arrives; the assistant will be re-invoked automatically when it does.

Otherwise, review everything completed in this session and ask: (1) Was all originally planned work actually implemented? (2) Were parallel sub-agents used for implementation? (3) Was an independent adversarial review done by a fresh sub-agent that assumed all work was wrong? (4) Was a completeness verification done? (5) Are you genuinely ≥95% confident all issues, related issues, and edge cases are covered? If ANY of these criteria is false or confidence is below 95%, return {"ok": false, "reason": "<specific description of what still needs to be done>"} to force continuation. Only return {"ok": true} if all five criteria are genuinely met or the remaining work is legitimately blocked on something outside the assistant's control (e.g. a user-owned decision). Note: any size/risk proportionality is the responsibility of the loaded qa-sweep skill's Proportionality section for Phase 2/3 implementation planning — not the final completion gate.

hooks.command: _GG="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || echo .)")/graphify-out/graph.json"; [ -f "$_GG" ] || exit 0; if python3 -c "" 2>/dev/null; then _GPY=python3; else _GPY=python; fi; HIT=$("$_GPY" -c "import json,sys,re;d=json.load(sys.stdin);c=str(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command','') or '');sys.stdout.write('1' if re.search(r'(?:^|[\\s;&|(])(?:grep|egrep|fgrep|rg|ripgrep|find|fd|ack|ag)\\b',c) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"PreToolUse\", \"additionalContext\": \"MANDATORY: the primary graphify knowledge graph exists. Run graphify query \\\"<question>\\\" --graph \\\"\$(dirname \\\"\$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)\\\")/graphify-out/graph.json\\\" before grepping raw files. Always pass --graph: inside a linked worktree the relative path does not resolve. Only grep after graphify has oriented you, or to modify/debug specific lines.\"}}"; fi

_GG="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || echo .)")/graphify-out/graph.json"; [ -f "$_GG" ] || exit 0; if python3 -c "" 2>/dev/null; then _GPY=python3; else _GPY=python; fi; HIT=$("$_GPY" -c "import json,sys,os;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh','.md','.rst','.txt','.mdx');skip={'claude.md','agents.md','skill.md','readme.md'};ex=lambda x:[x[:x.index('{')]+a+x[x.index('}')+1:] for a in x[x.index('{')+1:x.index('}')].split(',')] if '{' in x and '}' in x and x.index('{')<x.index('}') else [x];toks=[y.lower() for x in s.split() for y in ex(x)];hit=any(y.endswith(exts) and 'graphify-out/' not in y and os.path.basename(y) not in skip for y in toks);sys.stdout.write('1' if hit else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"PreToolUse\", \"additionalContext\": \"MANDATORY: the primary graphify knowledge graph exists. Resolve it with GRAPH=\\\"\$(dirname \\\"\$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)\\\")/graphify-out/graph.json\\\" then use graphify query \\\"<question>\\\" --graph \\\"\$GRAPH\\\" (scoped subgraph), graphify explain \\\"<concept>\\\" --graph \\\"\$GRAPH\\\", or graphify path \\\"<A>\\\" \\\"<B>\\\" --graph \\\"\$GRAPH\\\" before reading source files. Always pass --graph: inside a linked worktree the relative path does not resolve. The graph is AST-only, so treat it as orientation and confirm load-bearing claims against source. Only read raw files after graphify has oriented you, or to modify/debug specific lines. This applies to subagents too - include it in every subagent prompt involving code exploration.\"}}"; fi
